name: Fleet DLNA
description: Fleet-focused DLNA server for Jellyfin with fast browsing, Latest and Genres views, and profile-driven transcoding.
overview: Optimized DLNA for Samsung and LG television fleets.

versions.changelog: Updated for Jellyfin 12 and .NET 10. Includes upstream playback, discovery, MIME type, scoped-library, multi-part video, and compatibility fixes while preserving Fleet navigation.
Initial Fleet DLNA release with fast alphabetical browsing, Latest, Genres, and Samsung/LG optimizations.
